name: arkana-tarot
description: Fairly shuffled Rider–Waite–Smith tarot draws, spreads and card meanings.

interface.longDescription:
Arkana gives ChatGPT a real tarot deck. Ask for a reading and ChatGPT draws from a freshly shuffled 78-card Rider–Waite–Smith deck instead of picking cards itself, then interprets what actually came up.

What it can do:
• Deal any of nine spreads: a single card, past–present–future, situation–obstacle–advice, five-card cross, relationship, two paths, Celtic Cross, the year ahead, or your own positions.
• Draw clarifying cards from the rest of the deck, never repeating a card already on the table.
• Look up any card's upright and reversed meaning, element and image description.
• Every reading includes a link that shows the spread with the original 1909 card images.

No account needed. Card names and meanings are available in English and Lithuanian. Arkana is for entertainment and self-reflection; it does not give medical, legal or financial advice. The server stores neither questions nor readings.

positive.prompt: Draw a past, present, future tarot reading about my new job and explain it.
positive.expected_behavior: draw_cards returns three cards for Past, Present and Future, each with orientation and meaning, plus a link to view the spread with card images. ChatGPT interprets the drawn cards for the question.

positive.prompt: Do a Celtic Cross tarot reading about whether I should move to another city.
positive.expected_behavior: draw_cards returns ten different cards in the Celtic Cross positions (Present, Challenge, Foundation, Recent past, Conscious aim, Near future, Yourself, Environment, Hopes and fears, Outcome) with meanings and a view link.

positive.description: Single card, then a clarifying card
positive.prompt: Draw one tarot card for today, then draw a clarifying card for it.
positive.expected_behavior: draw_cards returns one card; draw_clarifier returns one more card from the rest of the deck that is different from the first card.

positive.prompt: What does the Queen of Cups reversed mean in tarot?
positive.expected_behavior: get_card returns the upright and reversed meanings of the Queen of Cups, its element (Water) and an image description. ChatGPT explains the reversed meaning.

positive.prompt: Which tarot spreads can Arkana do?
positive.expected_behavior: list_spreads returns the nine spreads with their number of cards and the meaning of each position.

publication.release_notes: First release of Arkana Tarot: fairly shuffled Rider–Waite–Smith tarot draws (nine spreads and custom positions), clarifying cards from the remaining deck, and card meanings in English and Lithuanian. No account required; read-only tools; no data stored.

lt-LT.subtitle: Sąžiningai sumaišytos kortos
lt-LT.description:
Arkana suteikia ChatGPT tikrą taro kaladę. Paprašius metimo, ChatGPT traukia kortas iš ką tik sumaišytos 78 kortų Rider–Waite–Smith kaladės, o ne renkasi jas pats, ir paaiškina, kas iškrito.

Ką galima daryti:
• Devyni išdėliojimai: viena korta, praeitis–dabartis–ateitis, situacija–kliūtis–patarimas, penkių kortų kryžius, santykiai, du keliai, Keltų kryžius, metų ratas arba savi klausimai.
• Paaiškinančios kortos iš likusios kaladės, be pasikartojimų.
• Bet kurios kortos reikšmė statmenai ir apverstai, elementas ir paveikslo aprašymas.
• Kiekvienas metimas turi nuorodą, kurioje jį matai su originaliais 1909 m. kortų paveikslėliais.

Paskyros nereikia. Arkana skirta pramogai ir savirefleksijai, ji neteikia medicininių, teisinių ar finansinių patarimų. Serveris nesaugo nei klausimų, nei metimų.
